passages.text: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys to David, along with cedar logs, stonemasons, and carpenters, to build a palace for him.
passages.sermon:
Hiram was the king of Tyre.
Hiram sent messengers to David.
Hiram sent cedar logs to David.
Hiram sent stonemasons to David.
Hiram sent carpenters to David.
They came to build a palace for David.
passages.original: וַ֠יִּשְׁלַח חִירָם מֶֽלֶךְ־ צֹ֥ר מַלְאָכִים֮ אֶל־ דָּוִיד֒ וַעֲצֵ֣י אֲרָזִ֔ים וְחָרָשֵׁ֣י קִ֔יר וְחָרָשֵׁ֖י עֵצִ֑ים לִבְנ֥וֹת ל֖וֹ בָּֽיִת׃

passages.text: And David realized that the LORD had established him as king over Israel and had highly exalted his kingdom for the sake of His people Israel.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
The LORD made David king.
David understood this.
The LORD lifted David’s kingdom high.
The LORD did this for His people Israel.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֣דַע דָּוִ֔יד כִּֽי־ הֱכִינ֧וֹ יְהוָ֛ה לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּֽי־ נִשֵּׂ֤את לְמַ֙עְלָה֙ מַלְכוּת֔וֹ בַּעֲב֖וּר עַמּ֥וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

passages.text: And David took more wives in Jerusalem and became the father of more sons and daughters.
passages.sermon:
David lived in Jerusalem.
David took more wives there.
David became the father of more sons.
David became the father of more daughters.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח דָּוִ֥יד ע֛וֹד נָשִׁ֖ים בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיּ֧וֹלֶד דָּוִ֛יד ע֖וֹד בָּנִ֥ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃

passages.text: These are the names of the children born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon, Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.
passages.sermon:
David lived in Jerusalem.
David had children born to him there.
These are the names of his children born in Jerusalem.
Shammua.
Shobab.
Nathan.
Solomon.
Ibhar.
Elishua.
Elpelet.
Nogah.
Nepheg.
Japhia.
Elishama.
Beeliada.
Eliphelet.
passages.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ שְׁמ֣וֹת הַיְלוּדִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיוּ־ ל֖וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם שַׁמּ֣וּעַ וְשׁוֹבָ֔ב נָתָ֖ן וּשְׁלֹמֹֽה׃ וְיִבְחָ֥ר וֶאֱלִישׁ֖וּעַ וְאֶלְפָּֽלֶט׃ וְנֹ֥גַהּ וְנֶ֖פֶג וְיָפִֽיעַ׃ וֶאֱלִישָׁמָ֥ע וּבְעֶלְיָדָ֖ע וֶאֱלִיפָֽלֶט׃

passages.text: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, they all went in search of him; but David learned of this and went out to face them.
passages.sermon:
David was anointed king over all Israel.
The Philistines heard this news.
All the Philistines went to look for David.
David heard about their plan.
David went out to face the Philistines.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמְע֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים כִּי־ נִמְשַׁ֨ח דָּוִ֤יד לְמֶ֙לֶךְ֙ עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיַּעֲל֥וּ כָל־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים לְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אֶת־ דָּוִ֑יד וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע דָּוִ֔יד וַיֵּצֵ֖א לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Now the Philistines had come and raided the Valley of Rephaim.
passages.sermon:
The Philistines were a group of enemies of Israel.
The Philistines came to the land.
They entered the Valley of Rephaim.
The Philistines raided the Valley of Rephaim.

passages.text: So David inquired of God, “Should I go up against the Philistines? Will You deliver them into my hand?” “Go,” replied the LORD, “for I will deliver them into your hand.”
passages.sermon:
David was king over all Israel.
David faced the Philistines, who were his enemies.
David asked God a question.
David said, “Should I go up against the Philistines?”
David also asked, “Will You give them into my hand?”
The LORD answered David.
The LORD said, “Go.”
The LORD said, “I will give the Philistines into your hand.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁאַ֨ל דָּוִ֤יד בֵּאלֹהִים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַאֶֽעֱלֶה֙ עַל־ פְּלִשְׁתִּיִּים וּנְתַתָּ֖ם בְּיָדִ֑י וַיֹּ֨אמֶר ל֤וֹ יְהוָה֙ עֲלֵ֔ה וּנְתַתִּ֖ים בְּיָדֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: So David and his men went up to Baal-perazim, where he defeated the Philistines and said, “Like a bursting flood, God has burst out against my enemies by my hand.” So they called that place Baal-perazim.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
The Philistines were his enemies.
David and his men went up to Baal-perazim.
David defeated the Philistines at that place.
David said, “God has broken through my enemies by my hand like a bursting flood.”
They called that place Baal-perazim.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲל֥וּ בְּבַֽעַל־ פְּרָצִים֮ וַיַּכֵּ֣ם שָׁ֣ם דָּוִיד֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד פָּרַ֨ץ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֧ים אֶת־ אוֹיְבַ֛י בְּיָדִ֖י כְּפֶ֣רֶץ מָ֑יִם עַל־ כֵּ֗ן קָֽרְא֛וּ שֵֽׁם־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֖וּא בַּ֥עַל פְּרָצִֽים׃

passages.text: There the Philistines abandoned their gods, and David ordered that they be burned in the fire.
passages.sermon: The Philistines left their gods there.\r\nDavid gave an order.\r\nThey burned the Philistines’ gods in the fire.
passages.original: וַיַּעַזְבוּ־ שָׁ֖ם אֶת־ אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד וַיִּשָּׂרְפ֖וּ בָּאֵֽשׁ׃פ

passages.text: Once again the Philistines raided the valley.
passages.sermon: The Philistines attacked again.\r\nThey raided the valley.

passages.text: So David again inquired of God, who answered him, “Do not march up after them, but circle around them and attack them in front of the balsam trees.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David faced the Philistines, who were enemies of Israel.
David asked God for guidance again.
God answered David.
God said, "Do not go up after the Philistines."
God told David, "Go around them."
God said, "Attack them from the front of the balsam trees."
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁאַ֨ל ע֤וֹד דָּוִיד֙ בֵּֽאלֹהִ֔ים וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים לֹ֥א תַֽעֲלֶ֖ה אַֽחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם הָסֵב֙ מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וּבָ֥אתָ לָהֶ֖ם מִמּ֥וּל הַבְּכָאִֽים׃

passages.text: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, move out to battle, because this will mean that God has marched out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to David.
God gave David a sign.
God said, “Listen for the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees.
When you hear this sound, go out to battle.
This sound means that I, God, have gone ahead of you.
I will strike the camp of the Philistines before you.”
passages.original: וִ֠יהִי כְּֽשָׁמְעֲךָ֞ אֶת־ ק֤וֹל הַצְּעָדָה֙ בְּרָאשֵׁ֣י הַבְּכָאִ֔ים אָ֖ז תֵּצֵ֣א בַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה כִּֽי־ יָצָ֤א הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ לְהַכּ֖וֹת אֶת־ מַחֲנֵ֥ה פְלִשְׁתִּֽים׃

passages.text: So David did as God had commanded him, and they struck down the army of the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
God gave David a command.
David obeyed God’s command.
David and his men attacked the Philistine army.
They defeated the Philistines.
They struck the Philistine army from Gibeon to Gezer.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ דָּוִ֔יד כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖הוּ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיַּכּוּ֙ אֶת־ מַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים מִגִּבְע֖וֹן וְעַד־ גָּֽזְרָה׃

passages.text: And David’s fame went out into every land, and the LORD caused all nations to fear him.
passages.sermon: David was king of Israel.\r\nDavid became famous in every land.\r\nThe LORD made all nations fear David.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א שֵׁם־ דָּוִ֖יד בְּכָל־ הָֽאֲרָצ֑וֹת וַֽיהוָ֛ה נָתַ֥ן אֶת־ פַּחְדּ֖וֹ עַל־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
